notablePrerequisites: You are able to generate an additional {E}{E}{E}{E} each turn.
description:
If Gonti's Aether Heart is in your graveyard, activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Gonti's Aether Heart.
Cast Gonti's Aether Heart either from your hand or graveyard by paying {6}.
Saheeli triggers, causing you to get {E}.
When Gonti's Aether Heart enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart that is a 5/5 artifact creature with haste.
Put the nontoken Gonti's Aether Heart into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Both Gonti's Aether Hearts trigger, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
If needed, generate up to an additional {E}{E}{E}{E} until you have eight {E} available.
Activate the Gonti's Aether Heart by paying eight {E} and exiling it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.name: Emry, Lurker of the Loch
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness if Gonti's Aether Heart is in your graveyard
